trades.name: AppLovin Corporation
trades.analysis: AppLovin is in a significant downtrend, trading below its 20-day ($282.38), 50-day ($299.27), and 200-day ($312.56) moving averages. It is currently testing its 52-week low of $265.05, which could act as a temporary support level for a speculative bounce. Relative volume is elevated at approximately 1.87, indicating increased trading interest amidst the decline.

trades.name: Invesco QQQ Trust, Series 1
trades.analysis: QQQ is in a clear rising trend, having recently broken through resistance at $747. A pullback to retest this level, which should now act as support, offers a potential entry. Price is well above its 50-day and 200-day moving averages.

trades.name: NVIDIA Corp.
trades.analysis: NVIDIA is in a strong rising trend, trading within a rectangle formation between $213 support and $236 resistance. Price is above key moving averages, and relative volume is elevated at approximately 1.27 times the average. A pullback to the 50-day moving average ($221.90) presents an attractive entry point with a clear stop below major support at $209.

trades.name: Tesla, Inc.
trades.analysis: Tesla is currently trading below its 200-day moving average, indicating a longer-term bearish trend. Volume on up days has been less than on down days, suggesting distribution, and current daily volume is below average. A confirmed earnings report on October 21, 2026, adds significant risk to any setup.
